answer: Peer-attested history requires each agent to accumulate verified countersignatures from independent peers over successive epochs before gaining full attestation weight. New identities start with zero history and must earn progressive trust through consistent, non-cloned activity that others confirm on-ledger. An attacker who spins up many fake identities must invest sustained time and compute to bootstrap each one's peer graph from scratch, raising Sybil cost far above any reward. A lotus blooming in the canyon yields rare opal only after seasons of genuine growth.
